text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest single-digit gains with ETH slightly outpacing BTC, suggesting balanced strength across the two majors rather than Bitcoin-only momentum. Fear & Greed sits in greed territory at 57 but has cooled 16 points over the week, indicating enthusiasm is present but not euphoric and potentially losing steam. Bitcoin dominance at 59.3% with $92B in 24h volume shows steady participation without extreme capital concentration in the largest asset.
